prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: first visual approval mockup for a friendly innkeeper NPC in the C++ dungeon game Stone & Shadow. This is a concept reference sheet, NOT an animation sprite sheet or UI.
Input images: Image 1 (goblin archer turnaround) is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its richly textured, detailed painted retro dungeon illustration, crisp silhouette, dimensional shading, restrained material colors, and gentle upper-left light. Do not use goblin anatomy, pointy ears, equipment, or expression. Image 2 (existing inn screenshot) is ENVIRONMENTAL CONTEXT ONLY: the human will eventually stand behind this wooden bar. Do not copy UI, text, perspective, room geometry, or produce a screenshot.
Primary request: ONE polished wide transparent character concept sheet showing the SAME friendly HUMAN innkeeper in four full-body idle views and one larger front-facing head-and-shoulders speaking expression study.
Subject: burly human man aged approximately 55–60, broad shoulders and thick strong forearms with a substantial comfortable belly, natural adult human proportions, ordinary round human ears, weathered warm face, smile lines and crow's feet, short greying hair with a slightly receding hairline, neat short salt-and-pepper beard and moustache. His eyes feel kind and attentive. A warm natural smile, a dependable welcoming innkeeper, grounded rather than cute or comical.
Wardrobe: off-white linen shirt with sleeves rolled above the elbows, worn brown waistcoat, simple faded brown work apron tied around his waist, dark brown trousers, sturdy worn leather boots. Practical clean-enough well-used medieval inn clothes, muted warm browns and linen, no jewelry, no weapons, no armor. Keep apron, beard, shirt, waistcoat and boots exactly consistent in all directions.
Composition: four evenly spaced full-body standing figures on the left and middle, ordered FRONT, PROFILE FACING SCREEN LEFT, BACK, PROFILE FACING SCREEN RIGHT. True cardinal views, same body scale and foot baseline, each body entirely visible with generous transparent space between figures and outside edges. Comfortable grounded standing idle posture, arms relaxed by his sides with hands clearly visible. On far right a separate larger front-facing head-and-shoulders study of the exact same man mid-conversation: lips slightly open naturally, kind eyes, small welcoming smile, no exaggerated open mouth. Four full bodies plus one bust total. No labels or text.
Style and lighting: hand-painted fantasy game character artwork matching the style reference, natural human anatomy, subtle worn fabric and leather textures, readable warm face, crisp non-pixelated contours and fine painterly shading. Subtle upper-left illumination that works with the inn. Friendly civilian character.
Constraints: genuine transparent alpha background. No floor, counter, tavern scene, contact-shadow ellipse, background gradient, checkerboard pattern, decorative frame, UI, logo, text or watermark. No animation frames, walking, attacking, weapon, mug, tray, props, or extra characters. Avoid stocky dwarf anatomy, huge caricature head, sinister expression, glossy 3D render, photograph, anime or cartoon simplification. All four full-body views must represent a coherent rotation of the same human identity, clothes and build; the fifth element is only his face expression study.
